beats.say: This railway bridge is taller than the Eiffel Tower.
The Chenab Bridge in Kashmir: the world's highest railway bridge.
beats.cap: Chenab Bridge, J&K: world's highest rail bridge

beats.say: Its deck sits three hundred and fifty-nine metres above the river.
One steel arch holds it all up.
It's built for storm winds, earthquakes, even blasts.
beats.cap: Built for 266 km/h winds · quakes · blasts

beats.say: Why so high? The Chenab cuts a deep Himalayan gorge.
This was the missing link joining the Kashmir Valley to India's railways.
In June twenty twenty-five, the first Vande Bharat trains crossed it.
Katra to Srinagar now takes about three hours, over the world's highest rail bridge.
